# Where Árgos works now: the myths behind the markets
If the stories are true in the way that matters, they should show up in the world without being invoked. **Árgos** shows up constantly.

Árgos exists within a single great story — the wanderings of Io — but it is one of the oldest stories the Greeks told, already old when Homer gave Hermês the epithet Argeiphontēs, 'Slayer of Árgos'.

The [pattern atlas](/patterns/) — which maps every flagship temple to the industries its archetype demonstrably resonates with, each match argued and open to challenge — seats this temple in **7 industries**. This file reads those seats the way they were earned: through the myths.
## At a Glance

- **Temple:** Árgos
- **Pantheon:** Greek
- **Domain of influence:** Vigilance, Hera's Watcher
- **Pattern seats:** 7
- **Sectors touched:** Technology & Innovation · Commerce & Governance · Culture & Entertainment · Home & Lifestyle
- **Strongest seat:** Cybersecurity & Digital Protection
- **Series:** The Resonance Files, No. 31 of 271
## The Myth at Work

**Hera Sets the Watch.** Zeús loved Io, daughter of the river-god Inachos, and to hide her from Hera — so the common telling runs — she was changed into a white cow.  Hera was not deceived. — that is not just a story. It is a business model, four thousand years early.

**The Herdsman Who Never Sleeps.** Árgos kept Io as a cowherd keeps a beast: by day she grazed under his eyes, by night she was bound.  The poets dwell on the horror of it — a princess eating grass, a guard with nowhere to look away. — remember the shape of that act. You will see it again, wearing a logo.
## The Seats

Each of these is argued in the atlas with a weight and a why-line. What the atlas cannot fit in one line is the whole myth — so here is each seat with its story restored.

### Cybersecurity & Digital Protection

*Threat defense, authentication, and digital trust. (Sector: Technology & Innovation)*

*The hundred eyes that never close — total monitoring, zero blind spots.* Swap the costume and the sentence is indistinguishable from the myth. That is what a resonance seat means.

### Defense, Military & Security

*Defense contracting, security services, and strategic studies. (Sector: Commerce & Governance)*

*Hera's appointed watchman over Io — guard duty personified.* Swap the costume and the sentence is indistinguishable from the myth. That is what a resonance seat means.

### Optics, Imaging & Vision

*Cameras, lenses, biometrics, and imaging science. (Sector: Culture & Entertainment)*

The why-line says it in one breath: *A hundred eyes covering every angle — vision itself as a brand.* That is not a resemblance; it is the same act, performed in a newer building.

### AI, Data & Predictive Intelligence

*Machine intelligence, analytics, and prediction markets. (Sector: Technology & Innovation)*

*Always-on perception feeding detection — the watcher in the machine.* — the atlas stops there, out of discipline. The myth keeps going: the function Árgos performs in the stories is precisely the function this industry sells.

### Beauty, Fashion & Cosmetics

*Cosmetics, fashion, and personal care. (Sector: Home & Lifestyle)*

*His hundred eyes set forever in Hera's peacock — the motif that outlived the giant.* Swap the costume and the sentence is indistinguishable from the myth. That is what a resonance seat means.

The temple holds 2 further seats beyond these — the full, argued list lives on its [patterns floor](/sites/argos/patterns/).

Read the myth again after the seats and it stops sounding ancient: Árgos exists within a single great story — the wanderings of Io — but it is one of the oldest stories the Greeks told, already old when Homer gave Hermês the epithet Argeiphontēs, 'Slayer of Árgos'. The age changed. The work did not.
## The Method, Stated Plainly

None of this is numerology. A seat exists only where the match can be argued from the deity's documented domains and deeds — weighted, published, and falsifiable. The full derivation, the weights, and the challenge process are public on the [methodology page](/patterns/methodology/). If a seat in this file reads wrong, the atlas itself tells you how to prove it — and the correction becomes part of the record.
## For the Ones Who Work There

If you work in cybersecurity & digital protection, defense, military & security, or any trade this temple holds a seat in, this is the honest version of what a placement means: your industry beside the story it has been re-telling all along — on the temple floor itself, before an audience that came specifically to read it. The [patron tier](/sites/argos/patron/) and the [advertising terms](/terms/advertising/) describe the mechanics; the resonance above describes the fit. The story is the pitch; the seats are just where it already works.
